Insurance

أساس التعرض

The underlying metric or unit used to quantify the amount of risk an insurer is covering, such as number of vehicles, payroll, sales, or property value.

Definition

The underlying metric or unit used to quantify the amount of risk an insurer is covering, such as number of vehicles, payroll, sales, or property value.

Operational example

Policy premiums are calculated using the exposure basis, such as annual revenue for liability insurance or insured value for property coverage.
